services.name: Dinosaur Dance Party & Baby Rave
services.desc: Get ready to meet some larger-than-life prehistoric friends in Dinosaur Dance Party, a joyful 30-minute Theatre for the Very Young experience filled with music, imagination, and discovery. Human-sized dinosaur puppets bring the adventure to life as children ages 1 to 5 and their grown-ups explore, interact, and play together. With plenty of opportunities to respond, participate, and experience the story up close, little ones are welcomed into a world where curiosity leads the way. And everyone knows one very important thing: dinosaurs love to dance! The experience also includes a Baby Rave, an open play and dance party led by Orlando Family Stage Teaching Artists.
